item.title: How to use Apollo Client in Angular
item.description: Apollo Client provides powerful GraphQL client with normalized caching, optimistic UI updates, and reactive queries for sophisticated data management in Angular. As the creator of CoreUI, a widely used open-source UI library, I’ve integrated Apollo Angular in enterprise applications. The most effective approach is using apollo-angular package which provides Angular-specific Apollo Client integration with observables and dependency injection. This method enables automatic cache updates, real-time subscriptions via WebSocket, and efficient data normalization across components.
